hero.title: Hi, I'm Arthur.
hero.subtitle: Most days I'm in Godot building something — a 2D jam game, a 3D cutscene, a low-poly character in Crocotile3D. I like when games feel good to play and look like they came from someone's head, not a template.

about.label: About
about.title: A bit about me
about.p1: I'm a designer and programmer from Brazil. I got into games because I wanted to make the weird ideas in my sketchbook actually playable.
about.p2: These days I split my time between Godot, Crocotile3D, and whatever tool fits the project. I'm picky about performance — I'd rather have a clean low-poly scene than a bloated one that chugs on a laptop.

modeling.label: 3D Modeling
modeling.title: Crocotile 3D
modeling.description: Crocotile is how I build most of my 3D stuff. You paint tiles directly onto the model, which sounds odd until you try it — then it clicks. Great for stylized games that need to run fast.

games.label: Games
games.title: Stuff I've made
games.description: Jams, experiments, things I'm still figuring out. Some are finished, some are very much not. All of them taught me something.

shatteredParadise.title: Shattered Paradise
shatteredParadise.subtitle: Godot JR Dev · One More Turn Studios
shatteredParadise.description: Roguelike dungeon crawler through Inferno, Purgatory, and Paradise — built in Godot by a small team at One More Turn Studios. I'm on the dev team, mostly stress-testing systems and building mechanics.

crimsonYule.title: The Crimson Yule
crimsonYule.subtitle: Occultism Simulator
crimsonYule.description: A dark ritual simulator I'm still building in Godot. There's an early trailer on YouTube if you want a peek at where it's headed.

andromeda.title: Take it to Andromeda
andromeda.subtitle: NES-style · 32 MB
andromeda.description: A Gorillaz fan game I made for the Lost Cartridge Jam. Short, loud, and very NES.

tiny4.title: Tiny 4 Bullets
tiny4.subtitle: 4 players, online
tiny4.description: You drive a train and shoot at the other team. Chaos with friends, basically.

panana.title: Panana & Gar
panana.subtitle: Adventure
panana.description: A hidden island somewhere in the ocean. Nobody from the outside has been there. I'm still building this one.

chip.title: Chip Keyboard
chip.subtitle: 38 MB
chip.description: Rhythm game where you press keys to not die. Simple idea, sweaty palms.

rdk.title: Rapid Deployment Killzone
rdk.subtitle: Third-person action
rdk.description: A stylish 3D shooter I'm working on in Godot. Intro cutscene made entirely inside the engine — no external video tools.

talora.title: Talora Roll Desk
talora.subtitle: In development
talora.description: A project I'm building around a roll-desk mechanic — still early, still figuring out the fun part.

future1.title: Next project
future1.description: Empty slot — I'll drop something here when it's ready.

web.label: Web
web.title: Websites too
web.description: I also do front-end work — responsive layouts, clean UI, sites that don't break on mobile. I treat every site like it should feel intentional, not generic.
web.experience: I used to work at Casa Civil do Estado do Rio de Janeiro, building institutional websites and design materials for government communication.

activities.web: Built and maintained official websites — responsive, accessible, actually usable.
activities.design: Layouts and visuals for digital government pieces.
activities.video: Planned, filmed, and edited institutional videos.

contact.label: Contact
contact.title: Want to work together?
contact.subtitle: I'm open to game collabs, 3D commissions, or just chatting about a project idea. No pressure — drop a line.

gamesPage.description: Godot is my main engine. I use it for 2D and 3D — cute stuff, dark humor, action scenes, whatever the game needs. These are the projects so far.

crocotilePage.description: I take commissions for low-poly models — characters, props, simple environments. Good for games that need style without killing the framerate.
crocotilePage.pricingText: One model: $6 USD · Pack of 5: $28 USD

planning.title: Planning
planning.description: Sketch the idea, pick a style, make a tilemap. References help a lot here.

modeling.title: Modeling
modeling.description: Block out shapes, then push vertices around until it looks right.

texturing.title: Texturing
texturing.description: Paint on the mesh with the tilemap. Keep it simple — that's the point of low-poly.

optimization.title: Optimization
optimization.description: Sort layers, check the mesh, make sure lighting reads well.

export.title: Export
export.description: Ship as .obj or .gltf. Tilemap included if you need it elsewhere.
